name: AERO-MED ORION-IV Demonstration Knowledge Base
description: Editable IF-THEN rules for the ORION-IV simulated mission dashboard. Thresholds are illustrative software-demo settings only, not validated medical or spacecraft operating limits.

rules.name: Critical simulated cabin CO2
rules.description: Detects a high simulated cabin partial-pressure CO2 value.
rules.message: The simulated cabin CO2 value is in the critical demonstration band.
rules.recommendation: Review the simulated CDRA / CO2-removal subsystem status and follow the instructor-approved scenario procedure.
rules.rationale: The configured demonstration rule marks ppCO2 values at or above 6.0 mmHg for critical review.

rules.name: Elevated simulated cabin CO2
rules.description: Detects an elevated simulated cabin partial-pressure CO2 value.
rules.message: The simulated cabin CO2 value exceeds the configured warning level.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the CO2-removal subsystem and monitor subsequent simulated readings.
rules.rationale: The demonstration warning threshold is greater than 4.5 mmHg.

rules.name: CO2 elevated while scrubber boost is inactive
rules.description: Combines elevated simulated CO2 with an inactive CDRA boost flag.
rules.message: CO2 is elevated while the simulated scrubber boost mode is inactive.
rules.recommendation: For this demonstration scenario, consider activating the simulated scrubber boost control and then re-evaluate.
rules.rationale: Both the elevated CO2 condition and inactive scrubber-boost flag matched. The engine only recommends a review; it does not actuate hardware.

rules.name: Low simulated cabin pressure
rules.description: Detects cabin pressure below the illustrative demo threshold.
rules.message: The simulated cabin pressure is below the configured demonstration limit.
rules.recommendation: Review pressure-sensor status and the simulated pressure-control subsystem; do not treat this as a real spacecraft procedure.
rules.rationale: The software demo rule triggers below 95.0 kPa. This value is configurable and not an approved operating limit.

rules.name: Low simulated cabin oxygen concentration
rules.description: Detects a low simulated oxygen concentration.
rules.message: The simulated cabin oxygen concentration is below the configured demo level.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the simulated oxygen-generation and atmosphere-monitoring subsystems.
rules.rationale: The demonstration rule triggers below 19.5 percent.

rules.name: Elevated simulated radiation flux
rules.description: Detects a high simulated radiation-flux value.
rules.message: The simulated radiation-flux value exceeds the configured demonstration threshold.
rules.recommendation: Review the simulated radiation-monitoring state and the scenario's shelter/shield controls.
rules.rationale: The current backend demo alert uses a 1.5 mSv/day trigger; this expert rule retains that software-demo threshold for consistency.

rules.name: Solar-storm scenario while shield is inactive
rules.description: Detects the solar-storm simulation while shield control is inactive and radiation flux is elevated.
rules.message: The solar-storm scenario is active, radiation flux is elevated, and the simulated shield is inactive.
rules.recommendation: Review the shelter and shield controls in the simulation. No physical shield or spacecraft control is connected to this expert system.
rules.rationale: This is a scenario-specific rule combining the scenario label, radiation value, and shield flag.

rules.name: Crew status marked critical
rules.description: Surfaces a CRITICAL status already present in the simulated crew record.
rules.message: The crew record is already marked CRITICAL by the simulation.
rules.recommendation: Review the simulated crew record and the active scenario; this flag is not a clinical assessment.
rules.rationale: The inference engine detected the explicit CRITICAL status value in the input data.

rules.name: High simulated heart rate
rules.description: Detects a heart-rate value above the illustrative demo threshold.
rules.message: The simulated heart-rate value exceeds the configured demonstration threshold.
rules.recommendation: Flag this simulated record for human review and inspect the scenario context.
rules.rationale: The demonstration rule triggers above 125 BPM; it is not a medical threshold.

rules.name: Elevated simulated heart rate
rules.description: Detects an elevated but non-critical simulated heart-rate value.
rules.message: The simulated heart-rate value is above the configured warning band.
rules.recommendation: Review activity context and observe subsequent simulated readings.
rules.rationale: The demonstration rule matches heart rate greater than 100 and no greater than 125 BPM.

rules.name: Low simulated SpO2
rules.description: Detects simulated SpO2 below the illustrative demo threshold.
rules.message: The simulated SpO2 value is below the configured demonstration threshold.
rules.recommendation: Flag the simulated record for human review; do not interpret this result as a diagnosis.
rules.rationale: The demonstration rule triggers below 94 percent.

rules.name: Reduced simulated SpO2
rules.description: Detects a reduced but non-critical simulated SpO2 value.
rules.message: The simulated SpO2 value is below the configured warning band.
rules.recommendation: Review the simulated sensor reading and scenario context.
rules.rationale: The demonstration rule matches SpO2 from 94 percent up to, but not including, 96 percent.

rules.name: Elevated simulated respiratory rate
rules.description: Detects a simulated respiratory-rate value above the illustrative demo threshold.
rules.message: The simulated respiratory-rate value is elevated relative to the configured demo rule.
rules.recommendation: Review activity and environmental scenario context, then observe subsequent simulated readings.
rules.rationale: The software-demo rule triggers above 24 breaths per minute.

rules.name: Elevated simulated body temperature
rules.description: Detects a simulated body-temperature value above the illustrative demo threshold.
rules.message: The simulated body-temperature value exceeds the configured demo rule.
rules.recommendation: Review the simulated record, its sensor quality, and the scenario context.
rules.rationale: The software-demo rule triggers above 38.0 °C; it is not a clinical threshold.

rules.name: Low crew sensor-node battery
rules.description: Detects a simulated sensor-node battery below the demo maintenance threshold.
rules.message: A simulated crew sensor node has a low battery value.
rules.recommendation: Review the sensor node and plan a simulated battery replacement or recharge.
rules.rationale: The demonstration maintenance rule triggers below 20 percent battery.

rules.name: Crew sensor node reports a fault
rules.description: Detects a sensor-node status other than OK.
rules.message: A crew sensor node is not reporting OK status in the simulated record.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the node connection and validate its next simulated reading.
rules.rationale: The status field is present and differs from the expected demo value OK.
